description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of stimulus types used in a study of generative AI’s use in journalism. The chart contains seven slices, each representing a different stimulus type. The largest slice, labeled “Stimulus” and colored teal, does not have a percentage indicated. The next largest slices are labeled “External News Article” (green) and “Social Media Post” (yellow), each representing approximately 18.1% of the total. Following these are “Press Release” (dark red) at 17.8%, “Interview” (purple) at 8.8%, “Organizational Website” (blue) at 6.6%, “Event Posting” (light purple) at 7.7%, and “Organizational Report” (grey) at 4.9%. A final, small slice is labeled “Draft/Other” (red) at 1.1%. Percentage labels are included directly within each slice, and the slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion. A legend is not present, but the chart is clearly labeled with the title “Stimulus Type” in the center.
